name: VoxelBlockyTypeLibrary with Attributes
definition: An alternative library type that contains a list of VoxelBlockyType objects instead of models directly. A type defines a 'block type' with attributes representing states (e.g., orientation, pressed state), similar to Minecraft block states.
summary: VoxelBlockyTypeLibrary with Attributes is a Minecraft-like system that automatically generates unique numerical IDs for every combination of block state attributes, decoupling model identity from manual ID assignment.
